text.p: Nomura Research Institute Europe Ltd rated Polish confectioner Jutrzenka SA as hold saying that although it found an attractive niche in production of wafers, it was facing strong competition in other product lines.

Nomura said in a report dated February 25 Jutrzenka was likely to depend increasingly on the domestic market for future expansion as it planned to restrict sales growth to risky and volatile markets of Ukraine and Russia.
"Strong competition will... mean that the company will find it difficult to maintain its rapid growth," the report said.
Nomura sees P/E ratio falling to 15.8 this year and to 12.7 in 1998, from 18.2 in 1996.
Jutrzenka closed at 65.5 zlotys on Thursday.
